summary:
The plan is in plan.md. It gives each of the eight plots exact block coordinates. Every house uses the same layout: storeys at y1–2 and y4–5 with ground floors level with the street, a front gable, a hip or a lean-to roof, and front doors on the south (high z) as the brief says.
The variety reads as the Presidio: a white house with a steep red roof, a porch and a brick chimney; a cream Mission duplex with a curved front parapet and two doors; a white garage and shed with dark grey roofs; a brick barracks with a two-storey white colonnade; a Spanish hall with an arched front arcade and a two-bell gable over its door; and a white Colonial house with green shutters, dormers and chimneys at both ends.
The battery is a low concrete block behind a grassy north slope rising to a parapet, with two round gun pits with iron rings, magazine doors and a stair on the south side, kept within y5; no roof dry-runs were done yet, since there's no build file, and no block named "chain" is used.
